Thank you for watching my hideous appearance…

Anyway! There’ll be no housewarming for the rest of my life...

Thank you for watching today.
Have a great week!

en-US.description:
Hi!

It's the second video!
I was gonna take a video of my daily life.

Due to the tiredness and hunger after the schedule (excuse..)
I ate, and ate.. Eventually didn’t even make it to the gym... It's been a day like that.

Anyways, hope you enjoy this show too!

ja.description:

2番目の映像ですね！

スケジュールが終わって疲れと空腹のせいで（言い訳になる） )
食べて、また食べて···。   結局運動も行けなかった…   そんな一日になりましたね。

とにかく今日も楽しく見てください！
